legacy_step32_mc_kappa.note: Legacy positive-branch MC draw with C in [0.5, 4.0] pinned SX and S3 at the 0.01 floor; superseded by published GLAFIC v3 kappa.

all_five_images.interpretation: Evaluated on the published GLAFIC v3 convergence kappa = [0.722, 0.733, 0.675, 0.727, 0.966] (Kelly et al. 2023; SX has the highest convergence at the smallest clustercentric radius 9.3 arcsec), the ansatz-free delay-kappa Spearman rank correlation is rho = +0.800 (exact one-sided permutation p = 0.0667, 95% CI [+0.300, +0.900]). In the TEP depth convention (1/|mu|, matching kappa_lens < 0 in Step 44), GLAFIC v3 macro-magnification gives rho = +0.700 (p = 0.1167) and flux-proxy depth gives rho = +0.300 (p = 0.3417). All three tracers carry the positive TEP sign.

inner_cross_only.interpretation: The inner cross alone shows no rank correlation with either kappa or mu. This confirms the proxy model is non-predictive without SX.
